import base64, gzip, json, re, urllib.request

def run(**kwargs):
    url = kwargs.get("url", "https://duskyr.com/login")
    patterns = kwargs.get("patterns", [
        r"fetch\([^)]{0,140}",
        r"/api/[A-Za-z0-9_/.-]+",
        r"localStorage\.[gs]etItem\([^)]{0,60}",
        r"Authorization[^\\n]{0,80}",
        r"(log[_ ]?in|sign[_ ]?up|register|signup)[^\\n]{0,100}",
        r"password[^\\n]{0,80}",
        r"dk_token[^\\n]{0,60}",
    ])
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    html = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read().decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def grab(tag):
        m = re.search(r'<script type="__bundler/' + tag + r'">(.*?)</script>', html, re.S)
        return m.group(1) if m else None

    manifest_raw = grab("manifest")
    if not manifest_raw:
        return "NO MANIFEST FOUND on " + url
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw)
    template = grab("template") or ""
    page_order = grab("page_order")
    pages = json.loads(page_order) if page_order else []

    out = []
    out.append("PAGE: %s | assets: %d | pages: %d" % (url, len(manifest), len(pages)))
    for uuid, entry in manifest.items():
        data = entry.get("data")
        if not data:
            out.append("ASSET %s: external url=%s mime=%s" % (uuid[:8], entry.get("url", "?"), entry.get("mime", "?")))
            continue
        try:
            raw = base64.b64decode(data)
            if entry.get("compressed"):
                raw = gzip.decompress(raw)
            text = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        except Exception as e:
            out.append("ASSET %s: DECODE FAIL %s" % (uuid[:8], e))
            continue
        mime = entry.get("mime", "?")
        is_page = uuid in pages
        hits = []
        for pat in patterns:
            try:
                found = re.findall(pat, text)
            except re.error:
                continue
            for f in found[:12]:
                if isinstance(f, tuple):
                    f = " | ".join(x for x in f if x)
                f = f.strip()
                if f and f not in hits:
                    hits.append(f[:200])
        out.append("=== ASSET %s mime=%s page=%s len=%d hits=%d" % (uuid[:8], mime, is_page, len(text), len(hits)))
        for h in hits:
            out.append("   " + h)
    return "\n".join(out)

import base64, gzip, json, re, os, urllib.request

def run(**kwargs):
    url = kwargs.get("url", "https://duskyr.com/login")
    outdir = kwargs.get("out_dir", "missions/duskyr.com/extractions/decoded_login")
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    html = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read().decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def grab(tag):
        m = re.search(r'<script type="__bundler/' + tag + r'">(.*?)</script>', html, re.S)
        return m.group(1) if m else None

    manifest = json.loads(grab("manifest"))
    template = grab("template") or ""
    saved = []
    # save template (the app HTML with {{ }} grammar)
    tp = os.path.join(outdir, "template.html")
    open(tp, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(template)
    saved.append("template.html (%d bytes)" % len(template))
    for uuid, entry in manifest.items():
        data = entry.get("data")
        if not data:
            continue
        try:
            raw = base64.b64decode(data)
            if entry.get("compressed"):
                raw = gzip.decompress(raw)
            text = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        except Exception:
            continue
        mime = entry.get("mime", "")
        if "javascript" in mime or "html" in mime or "json" in mime:
            fn = "%s.%s" % (uuid[:8], "js" if "javascript" in mime else ("html" if "html" in mime else "json"))
            fp = os.path.join(outdir, fn)
            open(fp, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
            saved.append("%s (%d bytes)" % (fn, len(text)))
    return "SAVED to %s:\n" % outdir + "\n".join(saved)
